text: D225298 changed DarkReader from regex manipulation to the browser’s parsed CSS rules after review. The author also shared sanitizeStyle between embedded rules and inline styles. This adds the accepted reason for the code already described in the linked source lesson. It applies to this DOM stylesheet operation; it is not a global ban on regex. Later rule guards and variable handling remain separate current-source refinements. Bug context remains incomplete; no complete audit or new runtime result is claimed.
title: Use parsed embedded CSS rules for DarkReader color edits
